what_may_and_may_not_be_claimed: The evidence is ABSTRACT-level: the searches returned these records with their abstracts, and the full texts were not read. So the honest statement is that the level-wise operator has strong, directly adjacent prior art -- a hierarchical hyperbolic product quantiser (HiHPQ) and mixed-curvature autoencoders -- and that a proposal in this direction would have to state its difference from those explicitly and pass a review. It is NOT the same as a verified refutation of every variant, and the full texts would be read before anything is closed as IMPLEMENTED prior art.
the_pattern: Two families in a row have now been closed by a targeted prior-art search rather than by an implementation or a GPU run: the hyperbolic residual chain (HRQ, HypRQ-VAE) and the level-wise factorisation (HiHPQ, mixed-curvature VAEs, decoupled RQ). The cost of each closure was eight queries and no training.
next: the portfolio's remaining candidate is the APPROVED product-geodesic level-0 quantiser, which is waiting on the operator's authorisation. If the next family has to come from here, the honest prior-art search must be aimed at an operator that is not a hyperbolic residual chain, not a per-level curvature schedule, and not a product-of-factors quantiser -- because all three are now occupied.
